history.summary: IDENTITY FLAG: two nearby candidate shrines exist - the best-documented is the Mankeswari/Mankeshwari temple on the hill at Jamgaon (Jamga), about 25 km east of Raigarh near the MSP Steel & Power plant (Justdial listing with 92 ratings; devotee video describing this location). A directory also lists 'Maa Mankeshwari Temple, Kolaibahal' about 19 km from Raigarh - the relationship between the two is unverified. Documented here as the Jamgaon temple, the hilltop Shakti shrine in Raigarh district; founding date and history are not published anywhere found (UNVERIFIED). Coordinates are approximate (verify).

town_description: Jamgaon is a village in Raigarh district, Chhattisgarh, about 25 km east of Raigarh city on the Raigarh road, near the MSP Steel & Power plant. The Maa Mankeshwari temple sits on a forested hill at Jamga/Jamgaon. Raigarh itself is an industrial city on the Kelo river, once a Gond princely state.
